entities.summary: The Botswana National Front (BNF) is a social democratic political party in Botswana. It was the main opposition party in Botswana from the 1969 elections until the 2024 elections. It is the largest component of the governing Umbrella for Democratic Change coalition; Party Leader Duma Boko has been President of Botswana since 2024. Botswana National Front is a political party in Gaborone, established in 1965. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
